title: LIMENORA CONNECT Policy Request
description: Client gateway request to the server policy service for a CONNECT decision. Shared contract between the Go and Rust gateways.

agent_token.description: Agent identity token presented by the client gateway.

host.description: Destination host for the CONNECT tunnel.

method.description: HTTP method when the decision is for a proxy request.

path.description: Request path when the decision is for a proxy request.

headers.description: Request headers relevant to the decision.

agent_ref.description: Resolved agent binding reference (NOMIVELA agent_ref); takes precedence over agent_token for the server resolver.

agent_id.description: External agent identity identifier carried by the resolved binding.

agent_class.description: NOMIVELA agent form (for example organizational, embedded, service).

identity_type.description: Agent Identity type carried by the resolved binding.

project_id.description: Project scope of the resolved binding.

tenant_id.description: Tenant scope of the resolved binding.

organization_id.description: Organization scope of the resolved binding. Falls back to tenant_id for organization-scoped policy when empty.

audience.description: Credential audience of the resolved binding.
